title: CARWatch R package now on CRAN
text: Version 1.0.1 of the CARWatch R package is now available on CRAN. It supports processing sampling logs, assessing sampling-time compliance, merging laboratory measurements, and analysing saliva data. Install it in R with install.packages("carwatch").

title: CARWatch Python package released
text: Version 1.0.0 of the CARWatch Python package is now available. It provides tools for loading, converting, validating, and analysing CARWatch logs and saliva data.

title: CARWatch iOS app updated to v1.1
text: Version 1.1 of the CARWatch iOS app is now available on the App Store.

title: CARWatch Android app updated to v3.0.1
text: The CARWatch Android app now has a refreshed design and updated participant workflows. The new release adds a study-details step during onboarding, clearer navigation, daily alarm and sample status overviews, pending wake-up and end-of-day alerts, and support for bedtime/evening sample reminders.

title: CARWatch iOS app released
text: The CARWatch iOS app is now available on the App Store! Let us know if you have any feedback or questions.
